svg.text: Body 33 mm outside, 23 mm bore, 10 mm long.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Back: inner lugs 8 mm wide, top and bottom, 11.5 to

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 13.9 mm from the centre. Front: outer lugs, 14.1 to

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 16.5 mm. Lug ends are rounded about the pin.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pin holes 2.0 mm (ream after printing), 2.6 mm from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each lug's root face, top and bottom.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Wire holes 1.2 mm on the two sides, 14 mm from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centre; run a 1.2 mm drill through each.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The faces close at 18 deg: that is the joint's stop.

svg.text: Check: two links pin together and swing 18 deg each way.
